title: His shadow lay over the rocks as he bent, ending. Why not endless till the farthest star? Darkly they are there behind this light, darkness shining in the brightness
html_source:
Stephen’s composing a poem, meditating on a poem , the only fragment of which completed is the vampire lines.

(Ulysses and the Metamorphosis of Stephen Dedalus
By Margaret McBride. p174).
